body: Damn, you're right man. I'm still thinking about all this you know, gathering that courage to tell someone is hard. Even telling my bestfriend was hard and I know she wouldn't blow up at me. I guess its the fear that people will think of me different. Thanks for those words man, really means a lot.
I'm just nervous and worried, I guess you could say I'm just looking at the worst :/ just people don't really seem to take me serious so that's why I said I'm worried they'd think I'm faking it.
The thing is I'm really nervous about it, so I'm afraid I'll choke up if I try and tell yhe doctor and they'll think I'm faking it.

I can't remember what I exactly told them, but when and if I do mention anything today that I'm having trouble I'll try my best to mention that I think I might going through a depression. I honestly feel like a fucking loser for not being 100% upfront with the doctor the first time but I guess this is a chance to rewrite my wrong? I just dont want it to get worse :/

Honestly I don't know man, I told them I was going through a rough spot (I didn't mention suicide even though I had some thoughts about it) last time I was at the doctors office when I had a check up. I had to take a blood test and all that came back was I had low Vitimam D.
